name: HARD OFF CORPORATION Co.,Ltd.
summary: All Time Plastics Limited, established in 1964 and based in Mumbai, makes and distributes molded plastic household goods, mainly under the alltime brand. It sells chiefly in India and exports to regions including the European Union, the United Kingdom and the United States. Kitchenware such as chopping boards, strainers, bowls and measuring tools form part of its catalog.
